# laravel_forge_providers (Data Source)

Data source for listing Forge cloud providers (DigitalOcean, AWS, Hetzner, etc.).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Retrieve all cloud providers
data "laravel_forge_providers" "all" {}

# Filter by slug
data "laravel_forge_providers" "digitalocean" {
  filter {
    name   = "slug"
    values = ["ocean2"]
  }
}

# Filter by name
data "laravel_forge_providers" "aws" {
  filter {
    name   = "name"
    values = ["Amazon"]
  }
}

# Output
output "all_providers" {
  value = data.laravel_forge_providers.all.providers
}

# Use provider ID in other data sources
output "do_provider_id" {
  value = length(data.laravel_forge_providers.digitalocean.providers) > 0 ? data.laravel_forge_providers.digitalocean.providers[0].id : null
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block List) Filter block for selecting specific cloud providers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `providers` (Attributes List) List of cloud providers available in Forge (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The field name to filter by (e.g., 'name', 'slug')
- `values` (List of String) The list of values to match for the specified field


<a id="nestedatt--providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `providers`

Read-Only:

- `currency` (String) The currency used by this provider
- `currency_symbol` (String) The currency symbol
- `default_region_code` (String) The default region code
- `default_size_code` (String) The default size code
- `id` (Number) The provider ID
- `name` (String) The provider name
- `simple_name` (String) The provider simple name
- `slug` (String) The provider slug
